title: Automating Quality Assessment of LLM-Generated Defeaters

live_model.evidence: '(75 for ACC and 97 for CERN) generated by GPT-4.' The paper's own reported F1 scores (e.g., 'SVM Meta and SVM Simple models achieve an F1 score of 0.84') are for its own SVM/LR quality-assessment classifiers, not for GPT-4.

prompt.note: The generation prompt used to have GPT-4 produce the 172 defeaters is not printed in the excerpt read.

claim.metric: none for GPT-4 itself (it only generates the defeater corpus that the authors' separate ML classifiers then assess)

data.source: ACC and CERN assurance-case defeaters generated by GPT-4; not confirmed released

notes: GPT-4/GPT-4-turbo is only a content-generation tool (role A) here; the paper's headline quality-assessment F1 scores (up to 0.86) belong to classical ML classifiers (SVM, LR) built by the authors, not to the LLM.
